about_the_game:
🛡️ RAIDBOUND

Strategic Viking Worker Placement Auto-Battler • Position-Driven Combat • Roguelite Progression

Lead a warband of fearless Vikings through a mythic land of glory, strategy, and bloodshed.
In Raidbound, you’ll recruit warriors, position them wisely, and watch them clash in brutal, cooldown-based auto-battles where tactics, timing, and team composition determine your fate.

⚔️ POSITION-BASED AUTO COMBAT

  • Combat plays out automatically once the battle begins — but your decisions before it start everything.

  • Vikings attack based on cooldowns modified by their speed.

  • Frontline targeting rules add deep tactical nuance: most units must break the enemy's line, one Viking at a time.

  • Unlock abilities that bend the rules: strike random enemies, displace targets, or cleave through multiple foes.

🧠 HERO PASSIVES & ABILITY SYNERGIES

  • Every run, choose from a variety of hero powers that shape your overall strategy.

  • Passives range from tank-saving effects to formation-breaking wildcards.

  • Stack buffs, status effects, and rune enhancements to create emergent combos across your Vikings.

  • Replay value comes from mixing heroes, drafting new powers, and discovering devastating synergy chains.

🪓 RUNE-ENHANCED CREW SYSTEM

  • Earn and equip powerful Runes to augment your Vikings with effects like:

    • Burn, poison, bleed, freeze, haste, armor, and more.

  • Runes are consumable power boosts — merge them to forge stronger variants.

  • Build run-specific loadouts to adapt to enemy types and draft RNG.

🔁 ROGUELITE PROGRESSION LOOP

  • Fight through a series of PvE and PvP rounds, each more intense than the last.

  • Losing a PvP battle costs health — but clever planning ensures you stay in the fight.

  • Each victory earns rewards and choices that evolve your strategy for the next encounter.

  • Runs end when all Vikings fall… or you become a legend of the leaderboard.

🧭 STRATEGIC WORLD MAP & EVENTS

  • Between battles, choose your path across a dynamic world map.

  • Visit Taverns, Blacksmiths, Runesmiths, Shrines, and Ritual Sites to power up your crew.

  • Special events offer high-risk, high-reward decisions — sacrifice a Viking for permanent buffs, or gamble for unique items.

🛠️ KEY FEATURES

  • 🧩 Deep tactical auto-battler with formation and cooldown-focused combat

  • 🔥 Strategic draft system and hero-defining passive powers

  • 🪄 Merge and manipulate Runes for customizable Viking effects

  • 🌌 Unique Viking classes and abilities with synergy-driven gameplay

  • ⚔️ Mix of PvE encounters and async PvP battles with ranked opponents

  • 🛡 No microtransactions – a fully premium, progression-based experience

Will your clan survive the chaos? Or will your saga be lost in the mist?
Prepare your warband. Forge your legacy. Become… Raidbound.

name: Raidbound

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows® 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GT 630 (2 GB) / AMD® Radeon™ HD 6670 (2 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 400 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows® 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-3570 (quad-core)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 650 (2 GB) / AMD® Radeon™ HD 7750 (2 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 400 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: Raidbound is a worker placement Viking auto-battler. Strategically place warriors, manage cooldown-based combat, and build synergy through runes and hero passives. Fight through PvE and PvP rounds in a roguelite system with no microtransactions—just brutal tactical progression.
